metrics.name: Python_object_size
metrics.scope: does not include transitive heap, interpreter or native allocation; no size probes executed

metrics.name: Python_heap
metrics.scope: native extension/OS mappings may be outside; not selected as whole-process cap

metrics.name: WorkingSetSize
metrics.scope: shared pages included per process; excludes AWE/large pages; no sum as unique physical RAM

metrics.name: PeakWorkingSetSize
metrics.method: GetProcessMemoryInfo on held unique process handle
metrics.scope: preferred observed whole-test-process working-set metric; last successful value covers history only through that query

metrics.name: PrivateUsage/PeakPagefileUsage
metrics.unit: private committed bytes/current or lifetime peak
metrics.scope: separate from physical residence, Python heap and working-set peak

metrics.name: job_commit_peak
metrics.unit: peak committed memory bytes for associated process/job
metrics.scope: kernel continuously tracks this job metric; cannot relabel as PeakWorkingSetSize

metrics.name: process_tree_total
metrics.unit: sum of same-time process metrics or native job commit metric
metrics.method: owned job membership and per-process snapshots
metrics.scope: sum of lifetime individual peaks is not simultaneous tree peak; shared WS pages may count more than once

metrics.name: postexit_persistent_resources
metrics.method: own ledger plus after-exit readback under separate budget
metrics.scope: distinct from reclaimed target address space; charge observer-held job/process handles and records

required_components: parent supervisor overhead separately, never free
test_owned_data_33554432_role: old proposal only; not a process working-set or native bound
933888_payload_role: explicit output-byte bound only; no RSS inference
measurement_plan: parent records source/process identity before resume
query OS peak/current/private commit while process is alive, each query success/error and QPC recorded
after wait-signaled exit attempt final process counters; do not assume memory API will still succeed
retain last good working-set peak with coverage end; if final query unavailable, any later preexit WS peak remains UNKNOWN
retain distinct kernel job commit peaks for terminated members; do not substitute them for missing final WS peak

hard_policy_options.working_set: SetProcessWorkingSetSizeEx with QUOTA_LIMITS_HARDWS_MAX_ENABLE, PROCESS_SET_QUOTA, OS-valid minimum/maximum; query/verify actual policy before resume; pre-policy peak still checked
hard_policy_options.committed_memory: private Job PROCESS_MEMORY/JOB_MEMORY limits enforce committed allocation separately
hard_policy_options.permission: own child only, minimal query/setquota rights; required privilege/API failure stops before resume; no automatic elevation
hard_policy_options.blind_spots: hard WS cap covers documented working-set definition, not AWE/nonpageable/native kernel allocations or whole observer; runtime closure still required

enforcement_semantics: sample-and-stop detects past peak breach; prospective hard policy does not prove the initial process-creation window or unobserved other metrics stayed within a number
on_breach: record known peak and coverage, mark resource exceeded, stop new operations and terminate only owned job; no refund/restart
error_bound: query timestamps bracket acquisition; no guessed interpolation or zero sampling uncertainty
